europe_now.summary: A ground station in Poland was damaged by a fire resulting from a suspected arson attack. The incident highlights rising regional security concerns regarding critical infrastructure.

europe_now.title: Diplomatic Engagement Between Poland and Belarus
europe_now.summary: The foreign ministers of Poland and Belarus held their first formal meeting in a decade to discuss improving bilateral ties. Both nations are exploring potential avenues for diplomatic rapprochement.
